note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground on a pine-covered peninsula in 500-acre Rob Roy Reservoir, 5.6 miles up Forest Route 500 from Albany. Tight hillside loops; some sites overlook the reservoir, most are tucked into the hillside. The adjacent Rob Roy Day Use Area has the boat ramp (campers need not pay again). --Claude
